sources: Spielmann, Joel & Impett (2019). Pursuing sex with an ex: Does it hinder breakup recovery? Archives of Sexual Behavior 48 (online 2018). Study 1: 113 recently broken-up participants, daily diary + survey 2 months later; Study 2: 372 participants. Pursuing sex with an ex not associated with hindered recovery; more common among those still attached; not linked to more distress. Quote: 'societal handwringing regarding trying to have sex with an ex may not be warranted'. Via ScienceDaily 2018-10-17.
